stem.text: Why does barium react more rapidly with cold water than magnesium does?

A.text: Barium atoms are larger and form ions more easily than magnesium atoms.

B.text: Barium floats on the surface of the water but magnesium sinks in the water.

C.text: Barium hydroxide is less soluble than magnesium hydroxide.

D.text: The sum of the 1st and 2nd ionisation energies of barium is more than that for magnesium.
